brief: Trial NCT01010373 (BioMAS). What is its status and stated reason? Put the trial in context with snapshot base rates.

findings.claim: Trial NCT01010373 has an overall status of SUSPENDED.
The stated why_stopped reason for NCT01010373 is "The sponsor is currently focusing on different indications", categorized as business/strategic.
NCT01010373 start date is January 2015, primary completion date is January 2016, and completion date is January 2016.
NCT01010373 enrollment is 12 patients, results are not posted, results due date was December 31, 2016, and it is 3,596 days late.
Across the snapshot, there are 16,473 trials, of which 3,739 are stopped. Among stopped trials, business/strategic is the most common reason category with 1,488 trials (39.8%).
In the snapshot, 30.9% of stopped trials with enrollment have no results posted, and 9.7% of stopped trials have a blank reason.
